summary: This is a truncated console log from a GitHub gist by user dpiet, created August 30, 2021, titled 'Console output after ros2-control package install check'. It records the output of running 'ros2 launch moveit2_tutorials demo.launch.py' on ROS 2 Foxy with a Panda robot arm. The log shows most nodes starting, the panda_arm_controller starting successfully, and the panda_hand_controller dying because its 'type' parameter was not defined. It also lists several warnings and errors from move_group, rviz2 and the class loader.
one_line: A truncated ROS 2 Foxy console log from a MoveIt2 Panda demo launch, showing controller startup and the panda_hand_controller failure.
key_facts: The gist is by user dpiet, titled 'Console output after ros2-control package install check', and was created August 30, 2021 16:47.
The launched command was 'ros2 launch moveit2_tutorials demo.launch.py'.
The launch started rviz2, static_transform_publisher, robot_state_publisher, move_group, ros2_control_node, mongo_wrapper_ros.py and three controller spawners.
The ros2_control_node reported that the controller_manager update rate is 100 Hz.
The panda_hand_controller failed with the error "The 'type' param not defined for 'panda_hand_controller'." and its process died with exit code 1.
The panda_arm_controller was configured and started, with command interface [position] and state interfaces [position velocity].
The panda_arm_controller publishes controller state at 50.00 Hz and monitors action status changes at 20.00 Hz.
The joint_state_controller was loaded, configured and started, and its spawner process finished cleanly.
The move_group node warned that Octomap resolution was not specified and assumed 0.1 instead.
The move_group node logged the error 'No 3D sensor plugin(s) defined for octomap updates'.
The move_group context used the planning plugin ompl_interface/OMPLPlanner and printed 'You can start planning now!'.
A MongoDB server (db version v3.6.8) started on localhost port 33829 with database path /tmp/db on host LAPTOP-N06C44K6.
rviz2 logged the error 'Action server: /recognize_objects not available'.
rviz2 logged the error that parameter 'panda_arm.kinematics_solver' has already been declared during loadRobotModel.
rviz2 populated 75 planners for the panda_arm group, including planner ids such as RRTConnectkConfigDefault and PRMstarkConfigDefault.
